verses.geez: ከመ፡ ዐውሎ፡ እንተ፡ ገዳም፡ ኀለፈ፡ ውስተ፡ በድው፡ ወመጽአ፡ እምብሔር፡ ግሩም።
verses.translation: The Vision of the Desert. As though a whirlwind should pass through the desert, coming from a desert, even from such a land,

translations.lxx: The Vision of the Desert. As though a whirlwind should pass through the desert, coming from a desert, even from such a land,
translations.kjv: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
translations.ron: Ca furtuna care vine de la miazănoapte, aceasta vine din pustiu, dintr-un ţinut înfricoşător.
translations.grk: Ὡς καταιγὶς διʼ ἐρήμου διέλθοι, ἐξ ἐρήμου ἐρχομένη ἐκ γῆς φοβερὸν

verses.translation: so a fearful and a grievous vision was declared to me: he that is treacherous deals treacherously, the transgressor transgresses. The Elamites are upon me, and the ambassadors of the Persians come against me: now will I groan and comfort myself.

translations.lxx: so a fearful and a grievous vision was declared to me: he that is treacherous deals treacherously, the transgressor transgresses. The Elamites are upon me, and the ambassadors of the Persians come against me: now will I groan and comfort myself.
translations.kjv: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
translations.ron: O vedenie grozavă mi s-a descoperit: jefuitorul jefuieşte şi pustiitorul pustieşte. Avântă-te, Elame! împresuraţi pe Mezi, n-aveţi nici o milă!
translations.grk: τὸ ὅραμα, καὶ σκληρὸν ἀνηγγέλη μοι· ὁ ἀθετῶν ἀθετεῖ, ὁ ἀνομῶν ἀνομεῖ· ἐπʼ ἐμοὶ οἱ Ἐλαμῖται, καὶ οἱ πρέσβεις τῶν Περσῶν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἔρχονται· νῦν στενάξω καὶ παρακαλέσω ἐμαυτόν.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይቀጸቅጸኒ፡ ሐቌየ፡ ወአኀዘኒ፡ ማሕምም፡ ከመ፡ እንተ፡ ትወልድ።
verses.translation: Therefore are my loins filled with feebleness, and pangs have seized me as a travailing woman: I dealt wrongfully that I might not hear; I hasted that I might not see.

translations.lxx: Therefore are my loins filled with feebleness, and pangs have seized me as a travailing woman: I dealt wrongfully that I might not hear; I hasted that I might not see.
translations.kjv: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
translations.ron: De aceea inima mea s-a umplut de nelinişte, dureri m-apucă, ca durerile unei femei care este gata să nască. înspăimântat cum sunt, nu mai aud; tulburat, nici că mai văd;
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο ἐνεπλήσθη ἡ ὀσφύς μου ἐκλύσεως, καὶ ὠδῖνες ἔλαβόν με ὡς τὴν τίκτουσαν· ἠδίκησα τοῦ μὴ ἀκοῦσαι, ἐσπούδασα τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν.

verses.geez: ስሕተ፡ ልብየ፡ ወደፈነኒ፡ ኃጢአትየ፡ ወደንገፀኒ፡ ነፍስየ።
verses.translation: My heart wanders, and transgression overwhelms me; my soul is occupied with fear.

translations.lxx: My heart wanders, and transgression overwhelms me; my soul is occupied with fear.
translations.kjv: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.
translations.ron: Duhul meu rătăceşte, frica dă năvală peşte mine. Noaptea care atât îmi plăcea mă umple de groază!
translations.grk: Ἡ καρδία μου πλανᾶται, καὶ ἡ ἀνομία με βαπτίζει, ἡ ψυχή μου ἐφέστηκεν εἰς φόβον.

verses.translation: Prepare the table, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and prepare your shields.

translations.lxx: Prepare the table, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and prepare your shields.
translations.kjv: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
translations.ron: Masa este pusă, aşternuturile întinse, toţi mănâncă şi beau. Voi, căpetenii, sculaţi-vă, prindeţi scutul!
translations.grk: Ἑτοίμασον τὴν τράπεζαν, φάγετε, πίετε· ἀναστάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες, ἑτοιμάσατε θυρεοὺς,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ከመዘ፡ ይቤለኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ ሑር፡ ፍጡነ፣፡ ፈኑ፡ ሰብአ፡ ዓይን፡ ወዘሰማዕከ፡ ዜኑ።
verses.translation: For thus said the Lord to me, Go and station a watchman for thyself, and declare whatever thou shalt see.

translations.lxx: For thus said the Lord to me, Go and station a watchman for thyself, and declare whatever thou shalt see.
translations.kjv: For thus hath the LORD said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
translations.ron: Că aşa zice Domnul către mine: "Du-te şi pune pe cineva de strajă, care să-Mi dea de ştire despre ceea ce va vedea!
translations.grk: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπε πρὸς μὲ Κύριος, Βαδίσας σεαυτῷ στῆσον σκοπὸν, καὶ ὃ ἂν ἴδῃς ἀνάγγειλον.

verses.geez: ወርኢኩ፡ ክልኤተ፡ መስተፅዕናነ፡ አፍራስ፡ እንዘ፡ ይፄዐኑ፤ አሕዱ፡ ይፄዐን፡ አድገ፡ ወአሐዱ፡ ይፄዐን፡ ገመለ።
verses.translation: And I saw two mounted horsemen, and a rider on an ass, and a rider on a camel.

translations.lxx: And I saw two mounted horsemen, and a rider on an ass, and a rider on a camel.
translations.kjv: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
translations.ron: Dacă va vedea călăreţi, doi câte doi pe cai, călăreţi pe asini, pe cămile, să se uite cu băgare de seamă, cu mare băgare de seamă".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶδον ἀναβάτας ἱππεῖς δύο, καὶ ἀναβάτη ὄνου, καὶ ἀναβάτην καμήλου· ἀκρόασαι ἀκρόασιν πολλήν,

verses.translation: Hearken with great attention, and call thou Urias to the watch-tower: the Lord has spoken. I stood continually during the day, and I stood in the camp all the night:

translations.lxx: Hearken with great attention, and call thou Urias to the watch-tower: the Lord has spoken. I stood continually during the day, and I stood in the camp all the night:
translations.kjv: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
translations.ron: Şi el a strigat ca un leu: "Stau de strajă, Doamne, neîncetat toată ziua şi la locul meu de veghe în fiecare noapte.
translations.grk: καὶ κάλεσον Οὐρίαν εἰς τὴν σκοπιάν· Κύριος εἶπεν, ἔστην διαπαντὸς ἡμέρας, καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἐγὼ ἔστην ὅλην τὴν νύκτα,

verses.geez: ወይመጽእ፡ መስተፅዕን፡ እምፍኖት፡ ወተሠጥወኒ፡ ወይቤ፤ ወድቀት፡ ባቢሎን፡ ወተቀጥቀጡ፡ ኵሉ፡ ጣዖታ፡ ወግብረ፡ እደዊሃ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: and, behold, he comes riding in a chariot and pair: and he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all her images and her idols have been crushed to the ground.

translations.lxx: and, behold, he comes riding in a chariot and pair: and he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all her images and her idols have been crushed to the ground.
translations.kjv: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
translations.ron: Şi iată că soseşte călărime, călăreţi doi câte doi". Şi el a vorbit şi a zis: "A căzut, a căzut Babilonul şi toate chipurile cioplite ale idolilor lui stau sfărâmate la pământ!"
translations.grk: καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτὸς ἔρχεται ἀναβάτης ξυνωρίδος· καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπε, πέπτωκε πέπτωκε Βαβυλὼν, καὶ πάντα τὰ ἀγάλματα αὐτῆς, καὶ τὰ χειροποίητα αὐτῆς συνετρίβησαν εἰς τὴν γῆν.

verses.geez: ስምዑ፡ እለ፡ ተረፍክሙ፡ ወእለሂ፡ ተሐሙ፣፡ ስምዑ፡ ዘሰማዕኩ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ አምላከ፡ እስራኤል፡ ዘዜነወኒ።
verses.translation: Hear, ye that are left, and ye that are in pain, hear what things I have heard of the Lord of hosts which the God of Israel has declared to us.

translations.lxx: Hear, ye that are left, and ye that are in pain, hear what things I have heard of the Lord of hosts which the God of Israel has declared to us.
translations.kjv: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
translations.ron: O, poporul meu, fecior al ariei mele, bătut cum se bate grâul, ceea ce am auzit de la Domnul Savaot, Dumnezeul lui Israel, ti le dau de ştire!
translations.grk: Ἀκούσατε οἱ καταλελειμμένοι, καὶ οἱ ὀδυνώμενοι ἀκούσατε ἃ ἤκουσα παρὰ Κυρίου σαβαὼθ, ὁ Θεὸς τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἀνήγγειλεν ἡμῖν. ΤΟ ὍΡΑΜΑ ΤΗΣ ἸΔΟΥΜΑΙΑΣ.

verses.geez: ጸውዖሙ፡ ኀቤየ፡ እምኀበ፡ ሴይር፤ ዕቀቡ፡ መዓቅብተ።
verses.translation: The Vision of Idumea. Call to me out of Seir; guard ye the bulwarks.

translations.lxx: The Vision of Idumea. Call to me out of Seir; guard ye the bulwarks.
translations.kjv: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
translations.ron: Proorocie despre Edom. Cineva strigă din Seir către mine: "Străjerule, cât a trecut din noapte? Străjerule, cât mai este până trece noaptea?
translations.grk: Πρὸς ἐμὲ κάλει παρὰ τοῦ Σηεὶρ, φυλάσσετε ἐπάλξεις.

verses.translation: I watch in the morning and the night: if thou wouldest enquire, enquire, and dwell by me.

translations.lxx: I watch in the morning and the night: if thou wouldest enquire, enquire, and dwell by me.
translations.kjv: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
translations.ron: Şi străjerul răspunde: "Dimineaţa se apropie, dar este încă noapte. De voiţi, întrebaţi, întoarceţi-vă şi veniţi iarăşi".
translations.grk: Φυλάσσω τοπρωῒ καὶ τὴν νύκτα· ἐὰν ζητῇς ζήτει, καὶ παρʼ ἐμοὶ οἴκει,

verses.geez: ወትበይት፡ ሌሊተ፡ ውስተ፡ ዖም፡ በፍኖተ፡ ዴዳን።
verses.translation: Thou mayest lodge in the forest in the evening, or in the way of Dædan.

translations.lxx: Thou mayest lodge in the forest in the evening, or in the way of Dædan.
translations.kjv: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
translations.ron: Proorocie despre Arabia. Într-o pădure de stepă petreceţi noaptea, voi, caravane din Dedan!
translations.grk: ἐν τῷ δρυμῷ ἑσπέρας κοιμηθῇς, ἢ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ Δαιδάν.

verses.geez: በቅድሜሆሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ጸምኡ፡ ማየ፡ አምጽኡ፡ እለ፡ ትነብሩ፡ ብሔረ፡ ቴማን፣፡ አምጽኡ፡ እክለ፡ ወተቀበልዎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ አምሠጡ።
verses.translation: Ye that dwell in the country of Thæman, bring water to meet him that is thirsty;

translations.lxx: Ye that dwell in the country of Thæman, bring water to meet him that is thirsty;
translations.kjv: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
translations.ron: Aduceţi apă celor însetaţi, voi, locuitori ai ţinutului Tema, întâmpinaţi cu pâine pe cei fugari,
translations.grk: Εἰς συνάντησιν διψῶντι ὕδωρ φέρετε οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν χώρᾳ Θαιμὰν, ἄρτοις συναντᾶτε τοῖς φεύγουσι

verses.geez: እምነ፡ ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ተቀትሉ፤ ወእምነ፡ ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ጐዩ፤ ወእምብዙኃን፡ ሰብአ፡ ኵናት፡ ወእምብዙኃን፡ ሰብአ፡ ሐፅ፡ ወአቅስቲሆሙ፡ ውሱቃት፤ ወበእንተ፡ ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ወድቁ፡ በውስተ፡ ቀትል።
verses.translation: meet the fugitives with bread, because of the multitude of the slain, and because of the multitude of them that lose their way, and because of the multitude of swords, and because of the multitude of bent bows, and because of the multitude of them that have fallen in war.

translations.lxx: meet the fugitives with bread, because of the multitude of the slain, and because of the multitude of them that lose their way, and because of the multitude of swords, and because of the multitude of bent bows, and because of the multitude of them that have fallen in war.
translations.kjv: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
translations.ron: Că ei au fugit dinaintea sabiei, din faţa sabiei scoase din teacă, de arcul întins şi de grozăviile războiului!
translations.grk: διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν πεφονευμένων, καὶ διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν πλανωμένων, καὶ διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς μαχαίρας, καὶ διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν τοξευμάτων τῶν διατεταμένων, καὶ διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν πεπτωκότων ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ከመዝ፡ ይቤለኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ ዓዲ፡ እምዓመት፡ እስከ፡ ዓመተ፡ ዓሳብ፡ የኀልቅ፡ ክብሮሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ቄዳር።
verses.translation: For thus said the Lord to me, Yet a year, as the year of an hireling, and the glory of the sons of Kedar shall fail:

translations.lxx: For thus said the Lord to me, Yet a year, as the year of an hireling, and the glory of the sons of Kedar shall fail:
translations.kjv: For thus hath the LORD said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
translations.ron: Că iată ce mi-a spus Domnul: "Încă un an, ca anii unui simbriaş, şi toată strălucirea lui Chedar se duce.
translations.grk: Διότι οὕτως εἶπέ μοι Κύριος, ἔτι ἐνιαυτὸς ὡς ἐνιαυτὸς μισθωτοῦ, ἐκλείψει ἡ δόξα τῶν υἱῶν Κηδὰρ,

verses.geez: ወእለ፡ ተርፉ፡ ነዳፍያን፡ ወጽኑዓን፡ እምደቂቀ፡ ቄዳር፡ የኀልቁ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: and the remnant of the strong bows of the sons of Kedar shall be small: for the Lord God of Israel has spoken it.

translations.lxx: and the remnant of the strong bows of the sons of Kedar shall be small: for the Lord God of Israel has spoken it.
translations.kjv: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken it.
translations.ron: Vitejii arcaşi ai fiilor lui Chedar se vor împuţina; că Domnul Dumnezeul lui Israel a grăit".
translations.grk: καὶ τὸ κατάλοιπον τῶν τοξευμάτων τῶν ἰσχυρῶν υἱῶν Κηδὰρ ἔσται ὀλίγον, ὅτι Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς Ἰσραὴλ ἐλάλησε. ΤΟ ῬΗΜΑ ΤΗΣ ΦΑΡΑΓΓΟΣ ΣΙΩΝ.
